tasks.description: Take off and climb to about 0.5 m altitude, then hold a stable hover. Stay upright.
Take off to about 0.5 m and hover in place at that altitude; keep your horizontal position steady (do not drift away).
Take off, then fly to a point about 0.4 m forward (+X) of your launch point while holding altitude near 0.5 m. Stay upright.
Take off and climb to about 1.0 m altitude, then hold. Stay upright.
Take off to ~0.5 m, fly about 0.5 m forward in +X, then fly back and stop above your launch point. Stay upright the whole time.
